sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Identify the correct article to fill in the blank: I read ___ amazing story about a brave king.
In the chapter 'Braille', who invented the reading system with raised dots for the visually impaired?
Identify the subject in the following sentence: 'The little brown bird sang sweetly in the morning.'
In 'The Old Stag', why did the stag originally look at his reflection in the clear water?
options: B) To look at his beautiful horns
D) To look at his thin legs
questions.answer: B) To look at his beautiful horns

questions.question_text: Which of the following is the correct collective noun for a group of wolves?
What is the central message of the story 'Together We Can'?
Replace the underlined word with the correct pronoun: '_Sarah_' is reading a book about road safety.
According to 'Be Smart Be Safe', what should you do right before crossing a busy road?
options: A) Run as fast as you can
B) Close your eyes and walk
C) Look left, right, and left again
D) Listen to music on headphones
questions.answer: C) Look left, right, and left again

questions.question_text: Choose the correct verb to complete the sentence: The dogs in the street ___ barking loudly at night.
Identify the helping verb in this sentence: 'He is playing basketball in the school garden.'

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: What moral lesson do we learn from the poem 'One Thing at a Time'? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The lesson teaches us that we should focus fully on a single task to complete it successfully, rather than doing many things at once and ruining them.

questions.question_text: Explain the difference between a common noun and a proper noun with one example of each. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A common noun names a general person, place, or thing, like 'city'. A proper noun names a specific one and starts with a capital letter, like 'Delhi'.

questions.question_text: In 'The Tinkling Bells', why were the villagers scared of the sound, and who was actually making it? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The villagers thought a forest demon was ringing the bells to scare them. In reality, a group of playful monkeys had found the bells and were shaking them.

questions.question_text: Name three different types of pronouns and provide one example sentence using any personal pronoun. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Three types of pronouns are personal, possessive, and demonstrative. An example of a personal pronoun in a sentence is: 'She is going to the park today.'

questions.question_text: How does the Braille system help visually impaired people read? Describe how the letters are formed. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The Braille system uses patterns of raised dots on thick paper. Visually impaired people read by running their fingertips over these dots to feel and understand the letters.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are the character from 'The Old Stag'. How did your feelings about your thin legs change when the hunters chased you? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: At first, I hated my thin, ugly legs and only loved my beautiful, grand horns. But when the hunters came, my heavy horns got stuck in the thick bushes, while my thin legs helped me run fast and saved my life.

questions.question_text: Applying the lessons from 'Be Smart Be Safe', imagine a stranger offers you a ride home from school in their car. Explain step-by-step how you would react to stay safe. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would firmly say 'No, thank you' and take a few steps back from the vehicle. I would never get inside the stranger's car. Then, I would immediately walk back into the school building and inform a teacher or a security guard.

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Formal Writing

questions.question_text: Write a formal application to your class teacher requesting a change of seat because you cannot see the blackboard clearly from the back row. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Respected Teacher, I am writing to inform you that I am having trouble seeing the blackboard clearly from my current seat in the last row. Therefore, I kindly request you to please change my seat to the front row so I can read properly. Thanking you, Yours obediently, Rohan.

questions.question_text: Write a short paragraph describing your favorite hobby. You must include at least one statement, one question, and one exclamatory sentence in your paragraph. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: My absolute favorite hobby is reading thrilling adventure books! Do you enjoy reading as well? Books transport me to magical lands filled with flying dragons and brave heroes. I usually read for an hour before going to bed every single night. Wow, I just love how exciting every new chapter is!
